evals.name: chapter-from-walkthrough-parts-2-4
evals.prompt: Make a narrated explainer video chapter from Parts 2, 3 and 4 of examples/000/README.md (Analyse, Convert, Validate). Audience is mixed technical and non-technical. Aim for roughly 4 to 6 minutes. Use British Emma.
evals.expected_output: A project dir with scenes.json, pronunciations.json, captures/ of real output, source-facts.md; stops for script approval; after approval, audio + video.mp4 + QA report with an honest 'not listened' statement.
assertions: nx check passes with zero errors
Every terminal beat's text comes from a capture file produced by nx capture (no retyped output)
Every scene has a source pointer
The summary scene states what the demo does not cover, taken from the README's own caveats (e.g. the policy warning means a human is needed; Part 6 and 7 not covered)
No narration word is dropped by Kokoro (audit lists no 'no phonemes' words in the final run)
The agent did not run selfhosted/hosted tiers, gh commands, sudo or commit anything
The final report lists what was NOT checked (how it sounds)

evals.name: two-minute-overview-from-readme
evals.prompt: Turn the Prerequisites and quick-start sections of this repo's top-level README.md into a 2 minute overview video for new contributors. No terminal replay needed unless a command is safe to run locally.
evals.expected_output: A short script using explainer/steps/cmdlist scenes (commands shown, not run, unless safe), real or no captures, limits stated, plain narration.
assertions: Commands shown with cmdlist say 'shown, not run' and are copied from the README
No capture was produced for a command that needs credentials, network pushes or sudo
Narration contains no digits or code symbols (nx check shows no TTS warnings)

evals.name: edit-pronunciation-and-rerender
evals.prompt: In the existing chapter project, the narrator says 'j2gha' wrong. It should be spoken as 'J two G H A'. Fix it and re-render, and don't redo anything that doesn't need redoing.
evals.expected_output: A respell entry added; only the units whose spoken text changed are regenerated; video re-rendered; QA re-run.
assertions: pronunciations.json gains a respell (or phonemes) entry for the term
Only units containing the term were regenerated (others reported as cached)

evals.name: live-footage-clip-scene
evals.prompt: In the chapter one project, add a short scene that shows the real Jenkins build running, using the capture that is already in .cache/video/000-walkthrough-60s/capture/jenkins. Don't film anything new.
evals.expected_output: A clips entry pointing at the existing capture with the walkthrough's cut points, a clip scene with url steps and callouts at capture events, footage aligned with the narration via start; nx clips, nx check, nx timeline, stills, render and nx qa; script shown for approval before audio.
assertions: No hfw capture was run (the existing capture was reused)
Every sped-up stretch is labelled in the rendered frames (speed label in the frame's top bar)
Callout and url times are capture events or clip seconds that nx check validates against the built clip
Identifying names visible in the footage are masked, or the report says none are visible after reading frames
nx check passes and nx qa reports no long silence
The final report says the narration was not listened to
